description: Core finite element method tools: function spaces, functions, forms, boundary conditions, expressions, and assembly.

classes.name: FunctionSpace
classes.description: A finite element function space. Wraps a C++ FunctionSpace. Use dolfinx.fem.functionspace() to create.

properties.name: dofmap
properties.description: Degree-of-freedom map for the function space.

properties.name: element
properties.description: Finite element of the function space.

properties.name: mesh
properties.description: Mesh on which the function space is defined.

properties.name: value_shape
properties.description: Value shape of the finite element field.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Create a copy of the function space with a new dofmap.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapse a subspace and return the collapsed space and map from new to old dofs.

methods.name: component
methods.description: Component index relative to the parent space.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Check if a function space is a subspace of this space.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Return a subspace at component i.

classes.name: Function
classes.description: A finite element function. Can be created from a FunctionSpace.

params.name: V
params.description: Function space to create the function on.

methods.name: interpolate
methods.description: Interpolate an expression or another function.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluate function at given points in given cells.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Return a copy of the function.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapse a function in a subspace.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Return a view into a sub-function.

classes.name: Constant
classes.description: A constant value over a domain.

params.name: domain
params.description: Mesh on which the constant is defined.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: Represents a UFL expression evaluated at specific points.

params.name: X
params.description: Points on the reference element to evaluate at.

classes.name: Form
classes.description: A compiled variational form. Wraps C++ dolfinx::fem::Form.

classes.name: DirichletBC
classes.description: Representation of a Dirichlet boundary condition. Use dirichletbc() to create.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Adjacency list of DOFs for all cells.

classes.name: CoordinateElement
classes.description: Coordinate element for mesh geometry representation.

functions.name: functionspace
functions.description: Create a FunctionSpace. Recommended factory function.

params.name: element
params.description: Finite element specification. Can be a tuple like ('Lagrange', degree).

params.name: dofs
params.description: DOF indices where BC is applied.

params.name: V
params.description: Function space (needed when value is not a Function in the same space).

functions.name: form
functions.description: Create a compiled Form from a UFL form.

functions.name: assemble_scalar
functions.description: Assemble a rank-0 form (scalar) on the calling process.

functions.name: assemble_vector
functions.description: Assemble a rank-1 form into a Vector.

functions.name: assemble_matrix
functions.description: Assemble a rank-2 form into a MatrixCSR.

functions.name: locate_dofs_topological
functions.description: Locate DOFs on mesh entities of a given topological dimension.

functions.name: locate_dofs_geometrical
functions.description: Locate DOFs using a geometric marker function.

params.name: marker
params.description: Function returning True for DOF coordinates on the boundary.

functions.name: set_bc
functions.description: Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions to a vector.

functions.name: create_sparsity_pattern
functions.description: Create a sparsity pattern from a bilinear form.

functions.name: create_interpolation_data
functions.description: Create data needed for non-matching mesh interpolation.
